en_title: Call of Duty: Black Ops Fans Discover Cut Zombies Content Over 15 Years After Release
cn_title: 《使命召唤：黑色行动》发现删减僵尸模式
subtitle: 十五年后的隐藏内容

paragraphs.en: Call of Duty: Black Ops fans have uncovered a new cut Zombies mode from the game, over a decade and a half after its original release.
paragraphs.cn: 《使命召唤：黑色行动》发售十五年多后，粉丝发现了一个从游戏中删去的全新僵尸模式。

paragraphs.en: YouTuber JTAG uncovered a tower defense Zombies mode in the recent PS4 port of Black Ops 1 and uploaded gameplay of it. It's clearly unfinished, so the mode is a bit crude, but players would've been able to place down turrets to stop hordes of the undead from advancing through a maze-like map. It seems as though the player would've been able to look down at the action from a bird's-eye view, not unlike Bloons Tower Defense, but they also would've been able to get on the ground and shoot enemies just like regular Call of Duty.
paragraphs.cn: YouTuber JTAG在近期PS4移植版《黑色行动1》中发现了塔防僵尸模式并上传实机画面。它显然未完成，较为粗糙；玩家原本可布置炮塔，阻止尸群穿过迷宫地图。玩家似乎可像《气球塔防》般俯瞰战局，也能落地像普通《使命召唤》那样射击敌人。

paragraphs.en: It's possible this was scrapped in favor of Dead Ops Arcade, a hidden Zombies mode in the original Black Ops game. The mode was a twin-stick arcade shooter that players could access by using a secret computer terminal in the main menu of Black Ops. The mode became a cult-classic and has returned in various Black Ops titles over the year.
paragraphs.cn: 它可能是为原版《黑色行动》隐藏僵尸模式《死亡行动街机版》让路而被删去。该模式是双摇杆街机射击游戏，玩家可通过主菜单的秘密电脑终端进入；它后来成为邪典经典，并多年间在多部《黑色行动》中回归。

paragraphs.en: Treyarch has experimented with the Zombies formula a lot over the years, and it's not exactly a surprise to see something like this turn up. The original Zombies mode was made by a small team of passionate developers who were developing the project in secret. It wasn't officially sanctioned by Activision and used recycled assets from Call of Duty: World at War. There was zero guarantee it would even make it into the final game, but once the team presented it to executives, they realized it was special and worth tacking on. And now, it's one of the most beloved pieces of the Call of Duty franchise.
paragraphs.cn: Treyarch多年间不断试验僵尸玩法，因此发现这种内容并不意外。最初的僵尸模式由一支充满热情的小团队秘密开发，未获动视正式批准，并复用了《使命召唤：战争世界》的素材。它原本完全不能保证进入成品，但团队展示给高层后，大家意识到其独特价值；如今它已成系列最受喜爱的组成部分之一。

paragraphs.en: It wouldn't be surprising if this tower defense mode was one of many experiments done to try and find more weird ways to expand the mode. It seems unlikely it will ever return, but it's cool to have a peek behind the curtain, especially when it's remained a secret for such a long time and may have never been discovered if not for the recent ports.
paragraphs.cn: 这款塔防模式很可能只是为探索更多奇特扩展方式所做的众多试验之一。它似乎不太可能回归，但能窥见幕后仍很有意思，尤其是它藏了如此之久，若非近期移植版甚至可能永远不会被发现。

summary: 《使命召唤：黑色行动1》PS4移植版中发现未完成的塔防僵尸模式，原本可在俯瞰与第一人称射击间切换。它或许曾为《死亡行动街机版》让路，展现Treyarch早期对僵尸玩法的实验。
opus_summary: 一段藏了十五年的未完成代码，让玩家看见《使命召唤》僵尸模式从秘密试验到系列招牌前，原本可能走向的另一条路，也保存了早期开发者大胆实验的痕迹。
